paper_cards.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
paper_cards.data: Nearly 20K interactive scenes and more than 10M generated navigation samples from posed RGB-D imagery.
paper_cards.method: Feature-Gaussian spatial anchoring plus Geometry-Aware One-Step Pixel Flow rendering, motion simulation, and automatic action/instruction annotation.
paper_cards.task: Build real-time interactive neural navigation environments and scalable training data from captured imagery.
paper_cards.novelty: Decouples 3D anchoring from photorealistic panoramic synthesis to make image collections executable as navigation simulators.
paper_cards.evidence: ArXiv abstract, public official GitHub diagram, and qualitative videos agree on the architecture and scale claims.

claim_checks.claim: Official public project repository and demos

paper_cards.limitations: Requires posed RGB-D and focuses on navigation; scale and transfer were not independently reproduced.

paper_cards.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
paper_cards.data: More than 50 hours of IsaacLab simulation and fewer than 2.5 hours of real dexterous demonstrations.
paper_cards.method: A mask-space dynamics model predicts future segmentation from 23-DoF actions, then a ControlNet-augmented video renderer produces RGB.
paper_cards.task: Action-conditioned long-horizon prediction and policy evaluation for dexterous manipulation.
paper_cards.novelty: Uses segmentation masks as a low-gap sim-to-real interface that preserves fine-grained action controllability.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper, official project page, narrated overview, long-horizon comparisons, and supplementary policy rollouts were inspected.
paper_cards.limitations: Constrained task/hardware family and no public code at inspection time.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct reference for separately evaluating dynamics, rendering, and action controllability.

paper_cards.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
paper_cards.data: 22 simulated MetaWorld/RLBench tasks and eight Franka real-world tasks with RGB-D/point-cloud observations.
paper_cards.method: Aligns 3D points with 2D positional embeddings, uses geometry-centric masked autoencoding for current/future point clouds, and predicts action chunks across LLM layers.
paper_cards.task: Geometry- and dynamics-aware language-conditioned robot manipulation.
paper_cards.novelty: Retains pretrained 2D knowledge while directly encoding 3D geometry and forecasting its action-relevant evolution.
paper_cards.evidence: ArXiv paper and official project page provide architecture, tables, and diverse real-robot/OOD videos.

claim_checks.notes: Multiple task and OOD videos inspected.

paper_cards.limitations: Requires 3D sensing; no code/checkpoint release confirmed and only one real-robot setup.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong link between spatial state evolution and executable VLA actions.

paper_cards.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
paper_cards.data: Large-scale video-action pretraining corpus plus simulation and real-robot manipulation evaluations reported by the authors.
paper_cards.method: Semantic visual-action tokenizer, native causal pretraining, sparse MoE backbone, and asynchronous closed-loop forward-dynamics inference.
paper_cards.task: Generalizable real-time robot control through joint video and action prediction.
paper_cards.novelty: Builds the video-action stack from scratch for embodiment rather than retrofitting a bidirectional reconstruction-oriented video generator.
paper_cards.evidence: ArXiv paper, official project release, and established public LingBot-VA code/model lineage support the central design and availability claims.

claim_checks.claim: Native causal pretraining with semantic visual-action tokenizer
Sparse MoE and asynchronous re-grounded inference

claim_checks.notes: Public lineage verified; exact 2.0 completeness needs recheck.

paper_cards.limitations: High compute/system complexity and incomplete independent verification of the exact 2.0 release assets.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Field-shaping world-action reference joining predictive dynamics, latency, and live feedback.
